title: Bishop McIntyre at Edwards AFB in 1954 during rumoured Eisenhower alien deal

tellings.quote: This is not even MJ-12. This is real records of this Bishop McIntyre hiring hanging around Edwards Air Force Base in '54 when you know, Eisenhower is rumored to you know, do his deal with the aliens

plain: A churchman known as Bishop McIntyre is said to have been hanging around Edwards Air Force Base in California in 1954. That is the year President Dwight D. Eisenhower is rumoured to have made a secret deal with aliens there. Michels tells it himself and says, unlike the MJ-12 papers, a disputed set of documents said to describe a secret UFO panel, this comes from real records, which he does not name.
